meta.title: Siegu — Your photo library, privately yours
meta.description: Siegu is a private, local-first photo library with on-device AI. Browse, search, share and relive your memories — without handing them to the cloud.

hero.subtitle: Siegu keeps every photo and video on your device. Powerful search, on-device AI, and seamless sharing — no cloud, no uploads, no compromises.

features.title: Everything your photos deserve
features.subtitle: A fast, private photo library that thinks the way you do.

listen.title: Private by design
listen.desc: Your photos never leave your device. No servers, no cloud, no uploads. Ever.

search.title: Natural-language search
search.desc: “beach in 2021” or “birthday cake” — find any moment in an instant with on-device AI.

organized.title: Auto-organized
organized.desc: Faces, places, trips and events, clustered automatically and kept private.

share.title: Privately share
share.desc: Share a whole collection over a live, encrypted link. Guests see only what you allow.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: Your library is local, so it works on a plane, in a cabin, anywhere.

speed.title: Blazing fast
speed.desc: Millions of photos, instant results. Your device does the heavy lifting.

showcase.title: A home for every memory
showcase.desc: Clean, calm and fast — Siegu turns your entire photo history into something you actually enjoy browsing.
showcase.caption: Your library, your rules.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.subtitle: Everything is local and private. Pay for convenience, not for your data.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: The full app on your device.

pricing.note: Prices in USD. Cancel anytime. No extra fees for more photos.

items.a: Yes. Your photos and metadata stay on your device. Siegu uses on-device AI, so nothing is uploaded for processing.
Absolutely. Your library is stored locally, so you can browse and search your photos anywhere — even without a connection.
You can share a collection over a live, end-to-end-encrypted link. Guests only see what you choose to share, and nothing is stored on our side.
Siegu runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, with a full web experience for guests.

items.q: Can I import from Google Photos or iCloud?
items.a: Yes — Siegu imports your existing library, then processes it all locally and privately.

cta.title: Take your photos back
cta.subtitle: Private, local, and yours. Siegu is ready when you are.
cta.note: No account, no uploads, no lock-in.

footer.made: Made with care — no cloud required.
